source.title: IS 456:2000 — Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice

rules.consequence: Treated as SHORT column. No buckling/buckling-amplification check needed.
rules.notes: Slenderness ratio = effective_length / least_lateral_dimension. For most residential columns (3m floor, braced) ratio < 10.

rules.consequence: Treated as SLENDER column. Buckling analysis required (P-delta effects).
rules.notes: Common case: stilt parking column unbraced over full ground floor height with thin section. Engineer must do buckling analysis.

rules.consequence: VIOLATION — unsupported length exceeds 60× least lateral dimension. Reduce length or increase column section.
rules.notes: Hard limit per IS 456 cl. 25.3. Refusal/redesign trigger.
